name: Low Step Aerobics

instructions.description: Stand facing a low stable step.
Step up with one foot, bring the other foot up, then step down.
Alternate the lead foot while keeping the rhythm controlled.
Reduce pace or stop if foot placement becomes inaccurate.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record average movement or step cadence.
Record the individual's perceived effort after the exercise.

variations.variationDescription: Low Step Aerobics — Interval Progression: Alternate manageable work and recovery periods while keeping the same activity.

commentsNotes: Use a low stable step and clear surrounding space.
